text: Read the entire audit log. Print the total number of events on the first line. Then, for every user with at least one `delete` action, print a line `<user> <number of delete actions>`, sorted by that number descending, then by user ascending.
tools: Returns one page of the audit log, oldest first. Omit the cursor for the first page; pass the previous page's next_cursor to get the next page. A page may contain zero events even when more pages follow. Fails with code INVALID_ARGUMENT for an unknown cursor.
